description: Submit text for an online text-entry assignment, exactly as given; the tool never writes content for you. Your instructor sees it and it counts as a submission attempt. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

name: submit_assignment_text
title: Submit Assignment Text
